name: Enforcement Doctrine
summary: Doctrine Benefit Riot Shield While using a shield, you gain +1 AC and advantage against being shoved. Executioner Your attacks against frightened, prone, or restrained creatures deal +1d6 damage. Investigator Gain expertise in Investigation or Insight. As a bonus action, study one creature, device, or scene you can see within 60 ft; until the end of your next turn, it counts as studied for your Investigator features. Uses: proficiency bonus per long rest.
